title: Predicting the prognosis in patients with sepsis by a pyroptosis-related gene signature.

models.outcome_definition: 28-day survival (time-to-event; 7/14/28-day time-dependent ROC); 28-day mortality in GSE95233
models.verbatim_formula: Risk score = [(-0.01470407 x GZMB expression value) + (-0.63970285 x CHMP7 expression value) + (-0.12447921 x NLRP1 expression value) + (-0.18172740 x MYD88 expression value) + (0.07255413 x ELANE expression value) + (-0.16451424 x AIM2 expression value)]
models.expression_scale_used: GSE65682 (GPL13667) array expression values as downloaded from GEO; exact transformation not stated (likely log2)
models.cutoff: median risk score (recomputed within each cohort)
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 discovery (n=263) tdAUC 0.70/0.68/0.65 at 7/14/28 d; GSE65682 validation (n=216) 0.66/0.63/0.64; whole GSE65682 (test) 0.69/0.65/0.64; GSE95233 (n=51) 28-day mortality AUC 0.687
models.source_location: Methods (prognostic model construction) + Results 'Development of a prognostic risk score' + Figures 3-4

models.outcome_definition: Consensus clusters (k=2) compared for survival; cluster 1 poorer prognosis
models.reported_performance: Kaplan-Meier survival difference between the two clusters in GSE65682 (Figure 2C); no AUC

notes: Training = GSE65682 discovery subset (n=263, original MARS discovery split); validation = GSE65682 validation subset (n=216); test = all 479 GSE65682 sepsis patients. DEGs vs 42 healthy controls in GSE65682. GSE95233 used for 28-day mortality validation and diagnostic ROC. Clustering model has no portable assignment rule. Text writes 'NLPR1' once (typo for NLRP1).
